push.title: W 3-0 vs GPFC Academy | You: 6.1 (bottom 25% MID)
push.body:
A 6.1, BellyTb1. Rough patch. But you know what grows in rough patches? Wildflowers.

DID WELL
+ 1 passes (down from your usual 23). Everybody wanted the ball at your feet, and for good reason.
+ Man of the Match, your 4th for us. The game noticed, and so did I.
+ Three points off GPFC Academy, 3-0. Put 'em in the bank and let 'em earn interest.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
- No key passes from 1 passes. Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
- Rating came in 1.1 below what your on-ball stats earned. Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press.
- 2.0 off your norm. Let it go like a bad haircut. It'll grow back.

This week's homework: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

Every great player has nights like this. Most of 'em just don't get a note from me. - Coach Lasso
